# The Kiln — measured overnight economics

> Measured economics of local-model batch work: a creative request parked overnight by a local cure-queue, delivered the next morning, with the full account of what it cost — machine minutes, cents of electricity, and the human presence that is the real cost line. Every number is regenerated by the extraction scripts shipped in this repo; every column carries its provenance. The refusal is deliberate and the honest gap is documented.

## Canonical links

- This repo (the measurement record): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-kiln
- Companion instrument, throughput numbers (stack-bench add-on): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-stack-bench
- Companion instrument, delegation trials (delegation-bench add-on): https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-delegation-bench
- ResonantOS (the ecosystem this gift is for): https://github.com/ResonantOS/2.0.0-alpha

## Key facts

- License: MIT.
- Every number script-backed: the `extract/` scripts regenerate the tables; hands-on totals reproduce only at the pinned database cutoff stated in the doc.
- 1,109 primary trials + 92 auxiliary rows across 13 delegation-bench result logs; banked throughput 17.6 tok/s decode, 224 tok/s prefill at 8k, 213 at 16k; overnight hold 11h15m, $0.03-0.06 of electricity at average residential rates.
- Honest gap: hands-on minutes are daily totals, not per-task; electricity is computed from average rates, not metered at the wall.
- Hardware disclosed in the doc: a 27B served from a mini-PC; the small-model run used a laptop Mac.

## Relationship

Community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — there is no external upstream: this repo's extraction scripts and the measurement record they regenerate are the canonical copy. The companion instruments above are canonical for their own numbers.
